title: ⚡ Bolt: Optimize PutawaySuggester memory footprint using database aggregation
body:
* 💡 What: Replaced an Eloquent query that hydrated all active `ProductLocationModel` instances with an optimized SQL `GROUP BY` aggregation query in `PutawaySuggester`.
* 🎯 Why: The original implementation looped over all active stock locations in PHP, doing calculations and lookups in memory. As the warehouse inventory grows, this causes severe memory spikes and O(N) performance degradation (where N is the number of active stock lines).
* 📊 Impact: Eliminates massive object hydration memory overhead. Reduces time complexity of the occupancy calculation from O(N) (all stock items) to O(L) (number of occupied locations), pushing the heavy lifting to the database layer.
* 🔬 Measurement: Observe memory consumption during a `suggestPutaway` execution on a large dataset; it should remain flat instead of spiking linearly with the number of inventory entries. CPU utilization for PHP will drastically reduce. Validate by running the full PHPUnit suite.
